senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; יָעַץ)counsel, advice, plan, consultation, council.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:2">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>נוטלין ע׳</he> they hold council, v. <cite ref="T00328"><he>רֶוַוח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 11a:7">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 1:10">Ex. I, 10</cite>) <he>הוא התחיל בע׳ תחלה</he> he was the first to propose (the destruction of Israel).
<cite ref="Exodus 1:10">Ib.</cite> <he>שלשה היו באותה ע׳</he> three men took part in that consultation.
<cite ref="Megillah 12b:7">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ניטלה ע׳ ממנו</he> counsel (legal wisdom) has been taken away from us.
<cite ref="Sotah 11b:23">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>שפנה מעֲצַת מרגלים</he> he turned away from the council of the spies.

<cite ref="Gittin 58a">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אם אתה שומע לעֲצָתִי</he> if thou wouldst listen to my advice. Tanḥ. Haăz. 8 <he>ובעצתי אל וכ׳</he> and if you follow my advice, do not risk your life for her.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 118a:7">B. Bath. 118ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ע׳ טובה קמשמע לן</he> good advice is meant by it (not a law); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֵצוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:17">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 3</cite> <he>שהיה יועץ ע׳ ומתקיימות וכ׳</he> who suggested plans which were executed, and which turned out well; a. e.
